prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1106; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck from behind.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Sugar Land, in the right lane, waiting to turn.

Q: How long had you been stopped before the impact?

A: Maybe fifteen or twenty seconds. The traffic in front of me had cleared, so I was just sitting there.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my car was pushed into the intersection a few feet.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: No. I was looking at the light and the cars ahead. I only saw it in my mirror after it hit me.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, but I felt dizzy and my neck was stiff. I sat on the curb until the officer arrived.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and was later referred to a physical therapist. I've been having neck pain, headaches, and stiffness in my shoulders.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: No, nothing that required treatment. I was working normally and exercising a few times a week.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add for the record?

A: Only that I want my treatment and any repair costs covered as quickly as possible. I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the pain.

Q: Understood. This concludes the statement. Thank you.
